ui_guide_text:
Main Mechanics

Food
Each crew member you feed costs 1 Food that day.
If anyone goes 3 days in a row without food, the voyage ends.
You are the Captain. Keeping everyone alive until Tahiti is on you.

Health
Healthy → Injured → Critical → Dead
An injury gets worse when its countdown runs out: Injured lasts 3 days, Critical lasts 2.
Mouthwash upkeep (1 Mouthwash) resets the countdown and buys time. It does not heal.
If anyone dies of their injuries, the voyage ends.
Sickness doesn't go away on its own. A Mouthwash cure (1 Mouthwash) clears it.

Airlock Day
Every 7th day is Airlock Day.
That night's dinner is laced with sedatives. Everyone who eats it is sedated.
You may exile one sedated crew member, or no one.
Anyone you don't feed that day can't be exiled.

Crew

Criminal — Loyalty
The Criminal has a Loyalty value.
Some choices take his side and raise it. Others go against him and lower it.
At maximum Loyalty he unlocks Intimidate.
Options marked [Intimidate] get done without paying their usual cost.
If his Loyalty ever falls back to 0 after that, he turns on you.

Worker — Negotiation
The Worker keeps the ship running and is the least likely to get hurt on a dangerous task.
But before he goes, he names his price: Food, Mouthwash, a promise, or something worse.
Break a promise and he'll sit out the next task.
If he learns the truth about the Airlock, he'll refuse dinner on Airlock Day.

Doctor — Medical Treatment
While the Doctor is on board and not Critical, her treatment (2 Mouthwash) fully heals an Injured or Critical crew member.
They can still get injured again later.

Chef — Food Efficiency
While the Chef is on board, every meal costs 1 less Food in total.
On Airlock Day the Chef laces the dinner. Without the Chef, you'll have to do it yourself.
journal_exiled_tied: {name} is tied up in the storage bay. The ship is finally quiet. So quiet it takes some getting used to.
